data.text:
new-react-component

New Component

Creates a React component, types, stylesheet and hook using the supplied values.

Pass one props object matching rab.settings.json. Call the TypeScript function exported from new-react-component.ts. The scaffold validates before writing, refuses an existing destination and returns the saved record. Name input in any text style is normalized to PascalCase for generated folders and files. It does not start tracking, discover tools, scan the world or run a CLI.
Supporting documentation: toolkits/rab-react/scaffolds/new-react-component/README.txt.
